title: Palace wants more Lacson-like senators to scrutinize 2027 budget

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Tuesday called for more senators like Sen. Panfilo Lacson to scrutinize the proposed P7.2-trillion 2027 national budget and weed out questionable allocations, as President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. warned to veto anew projects found to be anomalous. Palace press officer Claire Castro said Lacson’s findings on alleged ghost projects and duplicate appropriations would help ensure that public funds would not be wasted or diverted to the pockets of unscrupulous individuals. “We need more senators like Lacson to help ensure that our budget is better prepared and clean.
